financials_interim.notes: All figures LKR'000 as presented (no currency conversion needed). operating_profit = the company's own subtotal 'Results From Operating Activities' (before Finance Income/Expenses and Interest paid on leases). finance_costs = 'Finance Expenses' + 'Interest Paid to Government and Other Leases' (the filing splits lease/government-lease interest out separately from 'Finance Expenses'; both are combined here since both feed the company's own 'Net Finance Income' subtotal, which reconciles exactly to PBT). trade_receivables uses the single disclosed 'Trade and Other Receivables' line (no separate trade-only breakout given). short_term_borrowings/long_term_borrowings = Lease Liability (current/non-current) + Bank Overdraft (current only) -- TPL carries no conventional bank loans; the lease liabilities relate to government/estate leases and bear disclosed lease interest, so are treated as interest-bearing debt consistent with the P&L's 'Interest Paid to Government and Other Leases' line. capex = Purchase of Property, Plant & Equipment + Field Development Expenditure (plantation capex on immature bearer biological assets). Balance-sheet identity (total assets = total liabilities + total equity) ties out exactly to the rupee for both GROUP and COMPANY. EPS cross-check: PAT attributable / 47,500,001 shares in issue (per Note 2, includes one Golden Share held by the Secretary to the Treasury) reconciles to the disclosed EPS of Rs.3.99 (Group -- only basic EPS disclosed; diluted assumed equal as no dilutive instruments are mentioned) and Rs.4.14 (Company, disclosed as a combined Basic/Diluted figure). No column-swap issues were found.

interim_updates.note_text: Q1 FY2026/27 (three months ended 30 June 2026), Group basis, all figures Rs.'000. Revenue fell 7.1% YoY to Rs.1,871,969 from Rs.2,015,224, driven mainly by the Tea segment (~95% of turnover), which fell 7.7% to Rs.1,788,172 from Rs.1,936,569; Tea segment result fell a milder 3.9% (Rs.251,789 vs Rs.262,076) on matching cost reductions. The Rubber segment continued to run at a widening loss (-Rs.9,512 vs -Rs.8,773). Cinnamon segment result fell 24.0% to Rs.7,257 from Rs.9,552 despite cinnamon revenue more than doubling (Rs.26,556 vs Rs.10,961), because revenue expenditure rose even faster (Rs.18,062 vs Rs.887) -- a cost base that has scaled up ahead of the still-small top line. Mini Hydro Power segment result collapsed 86.6% to Rs.1,643 from Rs.12,280 as segment revenue fell 52.5% (Rs.9,672 vs Rs.20,348), consistent with lower generation that quarter. Group 'Results From Operating Activities' (operating profit) fell 11.1% to Rs.160,311 from Rs.180,253, yet Group PBT rose 6.1% to Rs.265,520 from Rs.250,190 and PAT rose 27.9% to Rs.189,475 from Rs.148,117. This was driven by Finance Income rising 37.4% to Rs.123,290 from Rs.89,726 (Net Finance Income up 50.4% to Rs.105,209 from Rs.69,936), plausibly reflecting the Rs.1,850,000 Non-Current Financial Assets investment added during FY2025/26 plus short-term investment balances, and by income tax expense falling 25.5% to Rs.76,045 from Rs.102,073. An interim dividend of Rs.1.42/share was paid in the quarter versus none in the prior-year comparative quarter.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for TPL -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. Only the filing's own prior-year comparative (three months ended 30 June 2025) is used for the YoY figures above.
interim_updates.takeaway: Core plantation/segment operating performance actually deteriorated YoY (segment operating result -11.1%, led by a -7.7% Tea revenue decline and a -86.6% collapse in Mini Hydro Power segment result), but Group PBT and PAT rose (+6.1% and +27.9% respectively) purely because Finance Income jumped +37.4% and the tax charge fell -25.5% -- the headline profit growth this quarter is not operationally driven and would reverse if finance income normalises.
operational_highlights: Group revenue down -7.1% YoY (Rs.1,871,969k vs Rs.2,015,224k); Tea segment (~95% of revenue) down -7.7% (Rs.1,788,172k vs Rs.1,936,569k)
Group 'Results From Operating Activities' (operating profit) down -11.1% to Rs.160,311k from Rs.180,253k
Finance Income up +37.4% to Rs.123,290k from Rs.89,726k; Net Finance Income up +50.4% to Rs.105,209k from Rs.69,936k, more than offsetting the operating decline
Group PBT up +6.1% to Rs.265,520k; PAT up +27.9% to Rs.189,475k, aided by income tax expense falling -25.5% to Rs.76,045k
Mini Hydro Power segment result fell -86.6% (Rs.1,643k vs Rs.12,280k) on a -52.5% drop in segment revenue
Rubber segment loss widened to -Rs.9,512k from -Rs.8,773k; Cinnamon segment result fell -24.0% to Rs.7,257k despite revenue more than doubling, on a much faster rise in cinnamon revenue expenditure
Interim dividend of Rs.1.42/share paid in the quarter (vs none in the prior-year comparative quarter)
key_drivers: Tea segment revenue decline (-7.7%) is the primary driver of the Group top-line fall, given it is ~95% of total revenue
Finance Income growth (+37.4%, Net Finance Income +50.4%), not core plantation operations, is the primary driver of the PBT/PAT improvement this quarter
Mini Hydro Power segment result fell -86.6% on lower generation/revenue, a small but sharply swinging contributor
Cinnamon segment cost base (revenue expenditure) is scaling up faster than its still-small revenue base, compressing segment margin even as revenue more than doubled
